protocol.split: SHA256 canonical [seed,source_group_id] sorted then round-robin folds
protocol.feature: FP64 arithmetic mean over the two saved raw-feature slots;11 channels per tile; no source/profile input
protocol.standardization: all11 channels using fold-training tiles only; std<=1e-12 becomes zero channel; intercept retained
protocol.target: original saved normalized_benefit FP32 converted to FP64; no scale or clip change
protocol.solver: zero coefficients; exactly200 full-batch gradient steps, fixed step1/lambda_max(Ztrain.T@Ztrain/n+ridge_diagonal); no line search or early stopping
protocol.constant: fold-training unregularized Huber minimizer interval using60 bisections per endpoint; closest-to-zero minimizer
protocol.primary_summary: held-out source macro mean; tile-micro summary separately
